description_text:
Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Software Engineers across enterprise and tech organizations.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Strong programming proficiency in a modern language (Python or Java).
- Required: Solid foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
- Required: Experience with SQL and relational database management (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
- Required: Hands-on experience designing and integrating REST APIs and microservices.
- Required: Proficiency with Git version control systems and Linux command-line environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with compiled systems languages such as C++ or Go.
- Experience with Docker containerization and Kubernetes orchestration.
- Experience deploying services to cloud infrastructure (Amazon Web Services AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform GCP).
- Familiarity with automated testing and continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Data Analysts and Business Intelligence specialists.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Advanced proficiency in SQL for data extraction, multi-table joins, aggregations, and window functions.
- Required: Practical experience in Python with Pandas and NumPy libraries for data cleaning and manipulation.
- Required: Hands-on experience developing interactive dashboards and KPI reports using Power BI or Tableau.
- Required: Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
- Strong data storytelling and quantitative problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning algorithms and Scikit-Learn.
- Familiarity with cloud data warehouses and big data frameworks like Apache Spark.
- Experience with version control using Git.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Backend Software Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Strong proficiency in a backend programming language (Python or Java).
- Required: Experience with enterprise backend frameworks like Spring Boot or FastAPI.
- Required: Deep understanding of REST API design, HTTP protocols, and microservices architecture.
- Required: Proficiency with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) including schema design and indexing.
- Required: Hands-on experience with Git version control and Linux environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Go, Node.js, or alternative backend runtimes.
- Experience with Docker containerization and Kubernetes cluster management.
- Hands-on experience with in-memory caching solutions like Redis.
- Knowledge of distributed systems, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Frontend Web Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and modern CSS.
- Required: Deep practical expertise with React component architecture, state management, and lifecycle hooks.
- Required: Experience integrating backend REST APIs and handling asynchronous data streams.
- Required: Strong understanding of responsive web design and modern build tooling.
- Required: Version control with Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with full-stack meta-frameworks like Next.js.
- Experience with Tailwind CSS or utility-first styling systems.
- Experience with GraphQL API consumption.
- Familiarity with frontend unit and integration testing.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Full Stack Software Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Frontend engineering proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern React.
- Required: Backend engineering expertise using Python, Node.js, or Java.
- Required: Practical experience designing REST APIs and connecting frontend client applications.
- Required: Solid proficiency in database querying with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) or NoSQL (MongoDB).
- Required: Proficiency with Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Docker containerization and cloud deployment on AWS or Azure.
- Familiarity with CI/CD automation pipelines.
- Experience with Next.js full-stack development.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for DevOps and Cloud Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Deep expertise in Linux operating system administration, shell scripting, and Python automation.
- Required: Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
- Required: Experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or GCP.
- Required: Experience configuring automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- Required: Version control proficiency with Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
- Experience with system observability and monitoring tools.
- Knowledge of cloud networking, security, and microservices architecture.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Strong programming expertise in Python with extensive use of Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-Learn.
- Required: Solid understanding of Machine Learning algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, ensemble methods).
- Required: Proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and feature engineering.
- Required: Strong statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and quantitative modeling foundations.
- Required: Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Experience with Docker and model deployment as REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask).
- Exposure to distributed data processing with Apache Spark and cloud ML platforms.

Role Summary: Standard industry technical requirements for QA and Test Automation Engineers.

Core Technical Requirements:
- Required: Practical programming skills in Python or Java for automated test development.
- Required: Experience designing automated end-to-end test suites using industry tools (Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress).
- Required: Practical knowledge of REST API testing and validation.
- Required: Familiarity with SQL databases for test data setup and verification.
- Required: Version control with Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines.
- Exposure to Docker containerized test environments.
- Knowledge of performance and load testing.
